HERO.DESCRIPTION: Youthful calm voice, great for narration and voice over.

GRIK.DESCRIPTION: A refined British male voice with a well-spoken, articulate delivery. The voice has a clear, polished tone with a natural sense of confidence and sophistication. It feels intelligent, composed, and professional without sounding overly formal or theatrical. The British accent is authentic and understated, with crisp pronunciation, smooth pacing, and excellent clarity. Ideal for professional narration, corporate presentations, documentaries, luxury brands, and authoritative yet approachable content.

CENTURION.DESCRIPTION:
A mature British male voice combining calm authority, natural warmth and intelligent conversational delivery. 

Clear, measured and reassuring, with the credibility of an experienced professional and the accessibility of a trusted colleague. 

Particularly suited to corporate narration, documentaries, educational content, technology explainers, professional presentations and thoughtful long-form storytelling.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Strange... why is everyone carrying their things?

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Even the old people and children are leaving. This doesn't look like a battle...

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: It looks like they're moving away.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: But... why does the whole village have to leave?

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: These aren't weapons...

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Water jars, blankets, pots... things they use every day.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: They even brought the children's favorite toys.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: They really have no choice but to leave.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: And... they may not even know if they can come back.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Don't come any closer!

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: We've moved three times today...

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Everyone is tired and hungry. I don't have the strength to fight you.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: I'm not here to fight.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Why do you keep moving deeper into the cave?

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: We're not hiding from you.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: We're hiding from this place.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Hiding from... your own home?

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Everyone who comes in carrying a weapon says they won't hurt us.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Come with me.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: When you see those places, you'll understand why we keep retreating deeper inside.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Last year, we still lived in the outermost part.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Then it became unsafe, so we had to move farther in.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Last month, we still lived here.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Now we can hardly stay here, either.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: The place where we slept is gone.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: There is less and less room to keep our food, too.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Even the path to get water is almost gone.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: So you weren't pushing outward to take more land...

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: The paths you used to take were disappearing, one by one.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: But the water is right there!

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: We could still walk this way yesterday.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: This morning, all the rocks came down.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: The children came with their buckets, but they could only stand here and look.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: So you didn't choose to keep moving inward...

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: The cave kept squeezing you farther and farther in.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: If this keeps going, you really won't have anywhere left to retreat.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Are you the leader here?

entries.SPEAKER: CENTURION
entries.EXACT_TEXT: No.

entries.SPEAKER: CENTURION
entries.EXACT_TEXT: I am the last gate.

entries.SPEAKER: CENTURION
entries.EXACT_TEXT: The elders, the children, and those who cannot fight are all behind me.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: But if you keep this path closed, they'll be trapped inside.

entries.SPEAKER: CENTURION
entries.EXACT_TEXT: You see me standing here and think I want land.

entries.SPEAKER: CENTURION
entries.EXACT_TEXT: But if I step aside, where can my people go?

entries.SPEAKER: CENTURION
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Do I want land, or do I want my people to live?

entries.SPEAKER: CENTURION
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Can you really tell the difference?

entries.SPEAKER: CENTURION
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Grik is willing to trust you.

entries.SPEAKER: CENTURION
entries.EXACT_TEXT: But I cannot put everyone's life in your hands just because he says so.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Then what should I do?

entries.SPEAKER: CENTURION
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Prove that you see more than your own path.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Your people need to survive.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: But other people cannot lose the path through here forever.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Then let me try.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: I'm not here to take your land.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: I'm looking for a path that won't force anyone else to leave.

entries.SPEAKER: CENTURION
entries.EXACT_TEXT: All right.

entries.SPEAKER: CENTURION
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Then let me see...

entries.SPEAKER: CENTURION
entries.EXACT_TEXT: whether you can really see the whole picture!

entries.SPEAKER: CENTURION
entries.EXACT_TEXT: You won.

entries.SPEAKER: CENTURION
entries.EXACT_TEXT: If you want to drive us away now, I have no reason left to stop you.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: I won't do that.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: I didn't win so you would have to move again.

entries.SPEAKER: CENTURION
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Don't call this a truce.

entries.SPEAKER: CENTURION
entries.EXACT_TEXT: I still don't fully trust you.

entries.SPEAKER: CENTURION
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Today... I am only willing to let you pass through here.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: At least tonight... the children won't have to move again.

entries.SPEAKER: CENTURION
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Only tonight.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Tonight is good enough.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: As for tomorrow's path, we can find it together.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Here. Take this.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: What is it?

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: A little piece of stone.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Whenever the wall pushes forward again, we leave a mark on it.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: No matter where we move, I keep carrying it.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Because I don't want to forget where we used to live.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: And I don't want to forget which paths have disappeared.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: So this might be a clue.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: You can look into it.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: But don't treat it as the answer.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: It can only tell you where a path once was.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: To learn what really happened, you still have to see it for yourself.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: I'll carry it.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: But I won't treat your homes as things I can take.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Where did this stone first leave a mark?

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Over by the forest.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Back when the mist wasn't so thick, we often took that path.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: We traded water, seeds, and food with the people from the forest.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: But later, the mist grew thicker and thicker.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: The paths disappeared, one by one.

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Lately, no one has come from the forest for a long time.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: The path through Goblin Cave is gone.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: And the path through Misty Forest is gone, too...

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: That can't be a coincidence.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Let's go!

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Let's go see what is happening in Misty Forest.

entries.SPEAKER: HERO
entries.EXACT_TEXT: I'll remember the path we came by!

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Don't just remember the path—

entries.SPEAKER: GRIK
entries.EXACT_TEXT: Remember who lives along it, too.
